description:

title: Remote Physics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Expert em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L.


Role Overview:

  • Design and solve challenging Physics problems to evaluate and identify the limitations of large language models.
  • Develop clear, high-quality, step-by-step solutions with precise and well-articulated reasoning.
  • Collaborate closely with LLM researchers to align problem design with evaluation objectives, particularly in areas where models typically struggle, such as abstraction, multi-step reasoning, and symbolic manipulation.
  • Contribute to the development of new evaluation benchmarks based on Physics curricula ranging from early undergraduate concepts to advanced PhD-level topics.
  • Analyze model outputs, identify reasoning gaps, and provide insights to improve model accuracy and performance.
  • Support the advancement of AI research by combining domain expertise in Physics with analytical and problem-solving methodologies.


Requirements :

  • Analytical Skills: Strong research and analytical abilities, with the capability to evaluate complex information and identify meaningful insights.
  • Feedback Skills: Ability to provide constructive feedback, detailed annotations, and clear evaluations to support continuous improvement.
  • Creative Thinking: Strong creative and lateral thinking skills, with the ability to approach problems from multiple perspectives and develop innovative solutions.
  • Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively in a remote and cross-functional environment.
  • Independence: Self-motivated, proactive, and capable of working independently while managing tasks and deadlines efficiently in a remote setting.
  • Technical Setup: Access to a reliable desktop or laptop and a stable high-speed internet connection to support remote collaboration and project work.


Preferred Qualification:

  • Candidates who have completed a Master’s, Ph.D., or Postdoctoral degree in Physics, Applied Physics, or a closely related field are eligible and strongly encouraged to apply.
  • Strong ability to analyze and solve complex Physics problems using a structured, logical, and methodical approach.
  • Ability to explain Physics concepts clearly and effectively through simplified explanations, visual representations, and strong conceptual reasoning.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.


The Role

This is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.


You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.


In practice, that means:

  • Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact
  • Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months
  • Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them
  • Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting
  • Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate
  • Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act
  • Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case


You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.


What this role requires

  • Fluent English: written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;

(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)

  • Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit
  • Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time
  • Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)
  • Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company


What will make you stand out

  • Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar
  • Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)
  • Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
  • Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality
  • Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies


What you'll be measured on

Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.


Compensation

Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Remote Mathematics Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Role Overview:

We are seeking highly skilled and motivated mathematicians with a strong understanding of intermediate to advanced mathematical concepts and the ability to apply these concepts creatively to complex problems. This role is ideal for individuals who thrive in tackling challenging questions and have a passion for deep mathematical reasoning and problem-solving. We are hiring both individuals who are strong in undergraduate level mathematics and as well as those who are strong in masters/PhD level mathematics. Turing works with most of the leading LLM companies in the world today and your work will enable today’s leading LLMs to attain advanced mathematics proficiency.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Develop and implement advanced mathematical models and computational techniques to address complex problems across diverse mathematical domains.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams on research initiatives, providing mathematical expertise and analytical insights.
  • Review and engage with the latest mathematical literature, including cutting-edge research papers and emerging methodologies.
  • Apply quantitative and computational approaches to analyze data, optimize models, and support innovative problem-solving strategies.
  • Contribute to the advancement of research projects through rigorous mathematical reasoning and technical proficiency.


Desired Skills and Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s, Master’s, or PhD degree in Mathematics or a closely related field, with strong expertise in one or more of the following areas: computable functions and mathematical logic, algebra and number theory, linear algebra and matrix theory, topology and geometry, real analysis, probability, and statistics.
  • Proven ability to solve complex mathematical problems, demonstrated through research experience, publications, academic achievements, or project work.
  • Knowledge of Python and data analysis tools is preferred, though not mandatory.
  • Excellent analytical and critical thinking skills, with strong attention to detail and problem-solving capabilities.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex mathematical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Collaborative mindset with experience working in multidisciplinary teams on research-driven or project-based initiatives.


More details on required skills:

Candidates should demonstrate strong expertise in at least 4 of the following 7 domains, with broader coverage considered a significant advantage:

Computable Functions and Mathematical Logic

  • Strong understanding of the theory of computation, computable functions, decision problems, and strategies for inferring functions from input-output relationships.

Algebra and Number Theory

  • Deep knowledge of algebraic structures, quadratic forms, signatures, prime numbers, Eisenstein series, and related concepts in number theory and their applications.

Linear Algebra and Matrix Theory

  • Proficiency in linear spaces, basis transformations, symmetric matrices, matrix equations, matrix diagonalization, and rank-related conditions.

Topology and Geometry

  • Understanding of vector bundles, cohomology, fundamental groups, commensurability, topological spaces, vector fields, and geometric proof techniques.

Analysis

  • Strong foundation in real analysis, including properties of functions almost everywhere, convergence concepts, continuity, and advanced analytical reasoning.

Probability and Statistics

  • Ability to apply probability theory to evaluate outcomes under varying conditions, along with experience using statistical techniques such as ANOVA for experimental and data analysis.

Applied Mathematics

  • Capability to apply mathematical reasoning and problem-solving techniques to practical scenarios, including logic-based and analytical challenges.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: at least 4 hours per day and up to 40 hours per week with 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type: Contractor


Evaluation Process:

  • Shortlisted candidates will be sent a Job Interest Form.
  • After the profile review, an assessment will be shared, which must be completed within 24 hours.
  • Based on the assessment outcomes, shortlisted candidates will be contacted to schedule an interview.


After applying, you will receive an email with a login link. Please use that link to access the portal and complete your profile.

title: IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist

IP Translation and Filing Client Care Specialist


Sun IP is a global leader in patent translation, foreign filing, and annuity solutions, helping intellectual property professionals protect innovation worldwide. We are looking for a motivated, process-focused, IP-knowledgeable Client Care Specialist to join our Filings and Translations department — a collaborative team dedicated to delivering exceptional service to a sophisticated global clientele.


Success in this role demands genuine IP knowledge and a meticulous eye for detail. You will be working across a high volume of concurrent matters, each with its own instructions, deadlines, and data requirements — so the ability to prioritize accurately and act before things escalate is essential. You will take a proactive approach to every interaction: anticipating what a client needs, ensuring records are complete and correct, and entering data with the precision that IP demands. This is not a reactive role. It is one where staying ahead of the work, asking the right questions early, and keeping every case moving is what defines a great day.


This is a role for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment and takes genuine satisfaction in getting the details right. You will manage multiple matters simultaneously across a diverse client base, bringing IP expertise, sharp judgment, and a client-first mindset to everything you do.


Main Responsibilities

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of global IP clients, handling enquiries with professionalism, accuracy, and a proactive approach to resolution.
  • Process patent translation requests in connection with international filings, ensuring all instructions are interpreted correctly and actioned without delay.
  • Manage client correspondence across high-volume shared inboxes, triaging and prioritizing matters according to urgency and deadline sensitivity.
  • Enter and maintain accurate data within our workflow management platform, upholding data integrity at every stage.
  • Follow up with clients on outstanding filing requirements, documentation, and approaching deadlines — anticipating gaps before they become issues.
  • Analyze complex filing instructions and translate them into clear, actionable tasks for internal teams, removing ambiguity and keeping matters on track.
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with Project Management, Accounting, Sales, and other departments to coordinate client deliverables and resolve escalations.
  • Identify and resolve inconsistencies or errors in client instructions, escalating where necessary and always keeping the client informed.
  • Produce and manipulate reports in Microsoft Excel to support internal tracking, client updates, and workflow oversight.
  • Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement by sharing process insights and supporting broader team and company objectives.
  • Manage proactive client contact, ensuring clients are kept informed at every stage of their matters and no update is left outstanding.
  • Act as primary contact for client profile management, maintaining accurate account records, preferences, and filing instructions across all platforms.
  • Lead client onboarding, guiding new clients through Sun IP’s processes, systems, and service offering to ensure a confident and informed start.
  • Deliver virtual training sessions for clients, equipping them with the knowledge to work effectively with our team and tools.


Required Experience

  • Prior experience in the patent filing industry; experience as a patent filing paralegal is strongly preferred.
  • Demonstrable experience processing patent translation requests in connection with international patent filings.
  • Hands-on experience with docketing systems or similar workflow management platforms.
  • Experience managing client-facing communication around filing requirements, deadlines, and documentation.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills - you can explain things clearly and confidently, whether in email, one-to-one call, or group meeting.


Skills & Competencies

-IP Knowledge & Process Orientation

  • Solid, working understanding of the patent filing lifecycle, related documentation requirements, and the implications of missed deadlines.
  • Ability to parse and act on complex filing instructions quickly and accurately, translating technical requirements into clear, step-by-step tasks.
  • A process-first mindset: you follow established workflows, flag deviations, and continuously look for ways to improve efficiency without sacrificing quality.


-Client Focus & Communication

  • Genuine commitment to client service — you take ownership of queries, communicate proactively, and never let a matter fall through the cracks.
  • Professional written and verbal communication skills, including polished client-facing email correspondence and confident participation in meetings.
  • Calm and composed under pressure, with the ability to manage urgent, time-sensitive matters without compromising accuracy or client experience.


-Organization & Problem Solving

  • Exceptional attention to detail: you spot errors, inconsistencies, and omissions that others miss, and you act on them decisively.
  • Strong organizational and prioritization skills, with a proven ability to manage a high volume of concurrent matters across varying deadlines.
  • Confident problem-solver who identifies root causes, considers options, and implements solutions - escalating only where genuinely necessary.

-Technical Proficiency

  • Accurate and efficient data entry.
  • Proficiency across multiple software platforms and case management systems; comfortable onboarding to new tools quickly.

title: Customer Success Manager
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Customer Success Manager em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Company Description

Mindhive Global is a New Zealand based, AI-driven technology company, operating at global scale. Using advanced machine vision and bespoke AI models, the company enables tanneries to grade hides accurately from wet-blue to finished leather and identify defects with greater accuracy and consistency than manual inspection. This verified quality data supports stronger supplier negotiations, improves traceability, and informs strategic decisions. By optimising order fulfillment and quality control, Mindhive Global helps customers increase efficiency, reduce waste, and build more resilient supply chains.


The Role

This is not a SaaS helpdesk role! It is TAM flavoured role, not a pure relationship role.


You will own the day-to-day success of a small portfolio of large, multi-year contracted enterprise accounts - each operating across multiple sites in multiple countries. You'll work across the full stack: hardware-enabled software deployments in industrial environments, platform adoption, data analysis, executive QBRs, and commercial expansion. You'll be the person who makes Mindhive's verified hide data deliver measurable business value for customers — and who documents and proves that it does.


In practice, that means:

  • Owning the full customer relationship across every stakeholder layer — from site operators on the production floor to executive sponsors in the boardroom — and building multi-threaded coverage so no account is ever dependent on a single contact
  • Driving onboarding and implementation as the primary customer contact, working alongside Field Operations through installation and onboarding, with a target of time-to-value under six months
  • Analysing operational and customer data site by site, translating findings into clear insights for both customer and internal audiences — and always validating findings against the customer's operational reality before presenting them
  • Running Quarterly Business Reviews with executive sponsors, owning the value realisation narrative, and documenting ROI in a form customers can take directly into their own internal reporting
  • Maintaining a five-dimension customer health dashboard — Relationship, Business Value, Operational Delivery, Adoption, and Commercial Momentum — and flagging risks before they escalate
  • Surfacing expansion opportunities — additional sites, new product lines, geographic rollouts — and handing them to Commercial with enough context to act
  • Supporting renewal preparation 12–18 months in advance, with a documented value summary and business case


You'll report directly to the Chief Customer Officer (who is based in Auckland New Zealand), and work alongside Commercial, Field Operations, and Product.


What this role requires

  • Fluent English: written and spoken; all customer and internal work is conducted in English;

(additional languages preferred, especially Portuguese)

  • Demonstrated experience managing more than three enterprise customers simultaneously , across multiple countries. If your experience is domestic or single-account, this role is not the right fit
  • Experience with large, strategic accounts on multi-year contracts: you understand how enterprise relationships are built and protected over time
  • Technical fluency in hardware-enabled software environments: you can engage credibly with IT and operations teams, understand system integrations, and interpret operational data without needing a translator
  • Willingness and ability to travel up to 50% internationally (Brazil, Argentina, UK, Germany, and expanding)
  • Ability to work as a full-time independent contractor, invoicing a New Zealand company


What will make you stand out

  • Background in sectors where technology is deployed into physical operational environments: manufacturing, food processing, mining, logistics, utilities, or similar
  • Experience with hardware + software deployments (definitely NOT pure SaaS)
  • Data analytics capability: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, or equivalent
  • Active, daily use of AI tools to improve your own output and analysis quality
  • Familiarity with formal customer success frameworks and methodologies


What you'll be measured on

Relationship health, documented ROI delivered for each account, platform adoption rates, onboarding time-to-value, and commercial expansion. You'll own the full customer health picture — not just satisfaction scores.


Compensation

Competitive, commensurate with experience. Paid in USD as a contractor engagement.

title: Salesperson
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesperson em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Overview

Full Spectrum Search Group is a national healthcare recruiting firm focused on post-acute and senior care leadership, including skilled nursing, senior living, home health, and hospice.

We are hiring a Recruiter to execute on active searches and drive candidate engagement across our client portfolio. This role is responsible for identifying, engaging, and advancing top talent through the interview process.

This is a phone-first, outbound recruiting role. Success in this position is driven by the ability to engage passive candidates and turn initial outreach into meaningful conversations.

If you are competitive, relationship-driven, and motivated by results, this role is for you.

About the Role

This role sits at the core of our recruiting execution. You will partner with leadership and work closely with the operations and research team to identify and engage candidates for active searches.

This is a production-driven role. Your success is measured by activity, candidate quality, and your ability to move candidates through the hiring process.

There is a steep but rewarding learning curve. You will be expected to quickly learn both our recruiting process and the nuances of the post-acute healthcare industry, including terminology, roles, and market dynamics.

Professional development is a core part of this role. The individuals who succeed here are those who actively invest in learning, improving, and refining their craft.

Candidate Sourcing and Outreach

  • Proactively identify and engage passive candidates through outbound calling, LinkedIn, CRM databases, referrals, and targeted call sheets
  • Prioritize phone-based outreach as the primary method of engagement, including calling candidates at their place of work when appropriate
  • Utilize call lists and target data provided by the research team to execute structured outreach campaigns
  • Supplement outreach with LinkedIn messaging, email, and text to increase response rates
  • Manage and respond to inbound candidates (Indeed, LinkedIn, referrals), while maintaining a primary focus on outbound recruiting

Candidate Qualification and Assessment

  • Conduct high-quality screening calls with both outbound (passive) and inbound candidates
  • Ask targeted, thoughtful questions to uncover experience, motivations, and openness to new opportunities
  • Present opportunities in a clear, compelling way that resonates with passive candidates
  • Accurately document candidate details including compensation expectations, timing, and potential barriers

Pipeline Management and Execution

  • Build and maintain a pipeline primarily driven by passive candidate outreach , not just inbound applicants
  • Manage multiple active searches simultaneously while maintaining organization and momentum
  • Ensure candidates are consistently moving through the process without delays
  • Prepare candidates for client interviews, including expectations, positioning, and feedback
  • Maintain accurate and up-to-date records in Crelate and related systems

Client and Team Collaboration

  • Partner with leadership to align on candidate profiles and search priorities
  • Communicate candidate updates, challenges, and market feedback in a timely manner
  • Work closely with the operations and research team to ensure strong execution across all searches
  • Contribute to team discussions around search strategy, candidate quality, and market trends

Performance Expectations

  • Maintain consistent daily call volume with a strong emphasis on outbound phone activity
  • Demonstrate the ability to engage and convert passive candidates into active conversations
  • Build a steady pipeline of qualified candidates sourced through outbound efforts
  • Deliver a consistent number of qualified candidate presentations per week
  • Maintain strong follow-up and response times with candidates and internal team members

What You’ll Bring

  • Strong verbal and written communication skills suitable for professional U.S. business communication
  • Understanding of American business culture, communication style, and professional expectations
  • Comfort with high-volume outreach and phone-based recruiting
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and maintain relationships with candidates
  • Strong organization and time management skills
  • Competitive, driven mindset with a desire to be successful
  • Positive attitude and ability to keep pace with a fast-moving, high-performing team
  • Strong technical proficiency and comfort learning new tools and systems
  • Professional home office setup suitable for business calls
  • Reliable high-speed internet and availability during U.S. business hours (Central Time)

What Separates Top Recruiters

  • You are comfortable calling candidates who are not actively looking and earning their interest
  • You default to picking up the phone instead of relying solely on messages or applications
  • You know how to turn a cold call into a meaningful career conversation
  • You actively invest time in learning the industry, terminology, and roles you recruit for
  • You generate your own pipeline rather than relying on inbound flow
  • You maintain persistence and follow-through without being transactional

Ideal Background

  • Experience in recruiting, sales, or other high-activity, performance-driven roles
  • Experience with outbound calling, business development, or candidate sourcing
  • Familiarity with healthcare or executive recruiting is a plus, but not required
  • Track record of meeting or exceeding performance expectations

Compensation and Logistics

  • Competitive monthly salary plus performance-based commission
  • Full-time remote position
  • Central Time schedule
  • Performance-based growth opportunities

title: Remote Physics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Physics Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:


Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Scientific Reasoning & Discovery Engineer is responsible for creating high-quality reasoning datasets that evaluate and enhance the scientific reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role focuses on designing data-driven scientific discovery tasks that require models to analyze experimental or simulated observations, identify patterns, infer governing laws, estimate parameters, and predict outcomes. The ideal candidate possesses strong expertise in scientific methodology, quantitative analysis, and mathematical modeling, with the ability to develop rigorous, reproducible, and logically consistent evaluation tasks.


What does day-to-day look like:

  • Designed scientific reasoning scenarios using experimental, observational, or simulated datasets.
  • Authored multi-step tasks requiring data analysis, pattern recognition, parameter estimation, and predictive reasoning.
  • Developed evaluation problems focused on law discovery, model selection, consistency checking, and hypothesis validation.
  • Created reference solutions, deterministic answers, and detailed scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and LLM engineers to ensure scientific accuracy, clarity, and reproducibility across datasets.


Required Qualifications:

  • Demonstrated 3+ years of experience in physics domain.
  • Applied strong knowledge of scientific reasoning, quantitative modeling, data analysis, and experimental methodologies.
  • Utilized expertise in mathematical modeling, parameter estimation, dimensional analysis, and simulation-based problem solving.
  • Communicated complex scientific concepts, assumptions, and solutions clearly through structured documentation.
  • Evaluated reasoning quality with strong attention to logical consistency, ambiguity control, and reproducible outcomes.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)

Nosso ambiente é descontraído, com uma cultura horizontal, muita troca de conhecimento, reconhecimento e desafios! Tá afim de fazer parte de tudo isso?

Dá uma olhada no que estamos buscando:


Estamos em busca de um(a) DBRE (Database Reliability Engineer) para atuar em um ambiente orientado por Data Mesh , com foco em resiliência, automação e governança de dados distribuídos . Essa pessoa será responsável por garantir a confiabilidade, performance e escalabilidade dos bancos de dados utilizados pelas equipes de produto e engenharia.


Responsabilidades:

  • Projetar e implementar estratégias de confiabilidade para bancos de dados em domínios distribuídos.
  • Automatizar processos de provisionamento, backup, monitoramento e recuperação de bancos de dados.
  • Trabalhar em parceria com os times de produto e engenharia para garantir boas práticas de modelagem e performance.
  • Atuar na observabilidade e rastreabilidade dos dados em ambientes SQL e NoSQL.
  • Participar da definição de padrões e políticas de governança de dados dentro da arquitetura Data Mesh.
  • Realizar troubleshooting e tuning de queries e estruturas de dados.
  • Gerenciar e otimizar recursos de banco de dados em AWS , utilizando serviços como RDS, Aurora, EC2, S3, CloudWatch, IAM e Secrets Manager .


Requisitos Técnicos:

  • Experiência avançada com SQL Server , PostgreSQL e MongoDB .
  • Domínio de AWS , especialmente em serviços voltados para bancos de dados e infraestrutura.
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código (IaC) com Terraform ou CloudFormation .
  • Automação com PowerShell, Bash ou Python .
  • Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento e observabilidade (ex: Prometheus, Grafana, ELK).
  • Familiaridade com arquitetura orientada a domínios (DDD) e Data Mesh .
  • Conhecimento em CI/CD e integração com pipelines de dados.
  • Experiência com ambientes cloud-native e containers (Docker, Kubernetes) .


O que você encontra aqui:

Remote First – Acreditamos no trabalho remoto como um estilo de vida. Nossas vagas são 100% remotas, mas caso queira trabalhar no nosso escritório em Porto Alegre/RS - é só chegar.

Comunidades Técnicas – Um espaço para galera trocar uma ideia, conversar sobre algum assunto específico e, claro, muita troca de conhecimentos.

Cultura de Feedback – Feedbacks estruturados periodicamente, buscando o desenvolvimento contínuo através de um Plano de Desenvolvimento Individual (PDI).

Horário Flexível - Autonomia para fazer a sua própria gestão da jornada de trabalho.

Incentivo ao Idioma - Temos como objetivo internacionalizar cada vez mais a Vortigo e você será parte disso!

Wellhub - Plataforma focada na saúde e bem-estar corporativo.

Reembolso de Equipamentos – Valor semestral de reembolso para compra de equipamentos que facilitam sua rotina de trabalho em casa.

title: Administrative Assistant
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Administrative Assistant em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Instead of applying to one remote job, you could access a community where new remote opportunities become available every week.


At Virtual Latinos, we connect experienced professionals from Latin America with growing companies in the U.S., Canada, and beyond that are building distributed remote teams. Our community includes more than 5,000+ professionals hired and 2,500+ companies that rely on Virtual Latinos to find skilled remote talent.


Join a community where you'll learn, connect with like-minded professionals, and access real remote opportunities with top North American companies.

Highlight Role of the Week!



Job Title: Administrative Assistant


Pay Rate LinkedIn style:


Part-time Monthly Rates: $800 to $1,280 (20 hours per week)


Full-time Monthly Rates: $1,600 to $2,560 (40 hours per week)


The monthly salary range posted is stipulated as an average monthly income. However, all jobs at Virtual Latinos are hourly-based, and payments are calculated based on the number of hours a person works daily. We pay our Virtual Professionals every 2 weeks through third-party platforms. The hourly rate range of the position is $10- $16, depending on experience. Once a rate has been offered to you, it is non-negotiable.



Work Schedule:


The work schedule will vary depending on the job position you apply for, as it will be based on the client's requested schedule. All our clients are in the U.S., and work schedules will be in the U.S. time zone.


Job Summary:


The Administrative Assistant will be responsible for providing administrative and customer service support, coordinating schedules, maintaining communication with internal and external teams, and managing tasks in a dynamic environment. The ideal candidate will be tech-savvy, detail-oriented, and proactive, supporting the client in a variety of tasks to ensure smooth daily operations.


Job Tasks:


  • Calendar Management: Organize schedules, book meetings, and keep calendars up to date.
  • Email Management: Review, prioritize, and organize emails professionally.
  • Task Tracking: Monitor tasks and deadlines using project management tools.
  • Documentation: Prepare reports, take meeting notes, and maintain organized digital files.
  • Customer Support: Communicate with clients and teams via email, chat, and phone as needed.
  • Research Assistance: Support with gathering information and summarizing findings when required.
  • General Admin: Assist with ad-hoc administrative and support tasks as assigned.


Qualifications:


  • 1 year of related experience and/or a related degree.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
  • Ability to excel in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong organizational abilities.
  • Meticulous attention to detail.
  • Collaborative team spirit.
  • Commitment to confidentiality.
  • A quiet, private workspace.
  • Must be at least 21 years old.


Software:


  • Google Workspace (Gmail, Calendar, Drive, Docs, Sheets, etc.)
  • WhatsApp
  • Asana
  • Miro
  • Canva
  • AI tools (flexible)
  • Open to other tools as needed


Languages:


  • English mandatory
  • Portuguese mandatory

  • Send your easy apply
  • We will reach out and send you a form to send in your full application
  • Get accepted into our community to have access to all our job offers
  • Apply to the job offers of your interest
  • Get interviewed
  • Start working in your dream job!

description:

JUNTE - SE À NOSSA COMUNIDADE DE TALENTOS!

Se você é comprometido, simples, objetivo, empreendedor, íntegro e respeita as pessoas em suas individualidades, com certeza tem a cara do Grupo Petrópolis.



O Grupo Petrópolis é a maior empresa de bebidas com capital 100% nacional. Produz as marcas de cerveja: Itaipava, Cabaré, Crystal, Lokal, Black Princess, Petra e Weltenburger, Brassaria Ampolis com otulo Cacildis, Biritis, Ditriguis e Forévi, as Vodkas Blue Sprit Ice e Nordka, a Cabaré Ice, os energéticos TNT Energy Drink e Magneto, o refrigerante It! Isotonico TNT sports Drinkse água Petra. O Grupo Petrópolis valoriza a diversidade e oferece oportunidade iguais a todos. Temos vagas de vendedor externo em todo Brasil



Principais Desafios

  • Efetuar vendas de produtos comercializados pela Unidade de Negócio Distribuição, através de visitas regulares nos Ponto de Vendas (PDV’), bem como captação de novos clientes, visando atingir as metas e objetivos comerciais, dentro das normas estabelecidas pela Empresa.


  • Executar o planejamento do dia, por meio da utilização de aplicativos de vendas e verificação de indicadores e meta do dia (preços, volumes acumulados, clientes movimentados etc.) e domínio do calendário promocional e de campanhas em conformidade, para alavancar resultados comercial.


  • Realizar o planejamento prévio à entrada no Ponto de Venda (PDV), através da verificação de pendências do cliente (devoluções, cortes, duplicatas, bloqueio, cheques devolvidos, solicitações, etc.), da checagem do histórico e metas do cliente e da leitura da loja, verificando oportunidades de inserção de produtos, mix existente, equipamento de refrigeração, perfil do estabelecimento e posicionamento de preços em relação ao principal concorrente, visando adequado relacionamento com cliente para aumentar a presença do nosso portfólio.



Requisitos.

  • CNH e ter veículo próprio
  • Atendimento ao Cliente, Técnicas de Vendas e Cálculos Matemáticos.
  • Ensino médio completo.


Benefícios.

  • Desconto em farmácias
  • Seguro de vida

title: Key Account Manager / Presales Lead
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Key Account Manager / Presales Lead em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About WorkPacks: Nestled in the vibrant tech ecosystem of the USA, WorkPacks is an innovative startup reshaping the construction industry's future. We're in search of daring individuals who are eager to disrupt, envision, and build anew. As trailblazers in the digital arena, we're stretching the limits of what's possible and warmly invite you to embark on this exhilarating venture with us.


Position Overview: We’re looking for a motivated Key Account Manager / Implementation Lead who will serve as both a relationship builder and implementation expert. In this role, you’ll be the primary point of contact for clients, ensuring our software solutions align with their needs and integrate seamlessly into their operations. This fully remote role combines client engagement with hands-on deployment, offering the opportunity to be directly involved in both client satisfaction and product success.


Responsibilities:


  • Client Relationship Management: Cultivate strong, lasting relationships with key clients, ensuring they feel supported and valued.
  • Primary Point of Contact: Serve as the primary liaison for assigned accounts, providing responsive and reliable client support.
  • Implementation Planning: Develop, document, and manage comprehensive implementation plans, including client-specific requirements, configurations, and any necessary customizations.
  • Data Specification Documentation: Prepare technical specifications and manage electronic data interface (EDI) setup with clients for seamless integration.
  • Deployment Leadership: Lead software implementations at client locations as required, managing deployment to ensure successful integration and operation.
  • Client Collaboration: Work closely with clients to thoroughly understand their project requirements and guarantee successful software adoption.
  • Technical Support & Troubleshooting: Deliver hands-on technical support during the implementation phase, addressing issues quickly to maintain satisfaction.
  • Client Training: Educate clients and their teams on using our software effectively, enabling them to gain maximum benefit from the tools.
  • Feedback Loop with Development: Collaborate closely with the product development team, sharing field insights and client feedback to support ongoing product improvements.


Qualifications:


  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Industry Experience: Minimum of 5 years of experience in the construction industry.
  • Technical Interest: Strong interest in construction technology and software solutions.
  • Communication Skills: Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective client engagement and support.
  • Problem-Solving Abilities: A detail-oriented approach with a proactive problem-solving mindset.
  • Multi-Project Management: Capability to manage multiple client accounts or projects simultaneously.
  • Willingness to Travel: Availability to travel to client sites as necessary.


Preferred Qualifications


  • Advanced Work Packaging (AWP): Familiarity with AWP methodologies.
  • Software Knowledge: Experience with construction management software or related technology.
  • Implementation Process Insight: Basic understanding of software implementation processes.
  • Client-Facing Experience: Previous experience in a client-focused role or account management.


Expectations


  • Remote Work: Fully remote position with flexibility and some overlap required with U.S. working hours.
  • Autonomous Drive: Proactive, creative, and capable of driving projects forward independently.
  • Hands-on Approach: Eager to engage with both client challenges and technical solutions directly.


Compensation:

  • Salary: Competitive salary starting at $55,000/year.
  • Benefits: Comprehensive health and wellness benefits.
  • Growth Opportunities: Paths for professional development and career advancement within the company.
  • Culture: A collaborative, inclusive, and innovation-driven workplace that values teamwork and individual initiative.


This role is perfect for a client-focused, tech-savvy professional passionate about transforming the construction industry through technology. Join us to shape the future of construction, drive client success, and take the lead in groundbreaking software implementations!

title: Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Toptal is a global network of top talent in business, design, and technology that helps companies scale their teams on demand.


A Salesforce Marketing Cloud Expert is needed to design, build, launch, and optimize email, messaging, segmentation, and automation solutions. This role will support critical marketing technology initiatives, guide junior developers, and act as a module lead or point of contact for one or more markets or countries.


The role involves working across email development, journey orchestration, audience segmentation, reporting, and platform process improvements.

The expert will work with geographically distributed teams, including developers, project managers, and market stakeholders. Key objectives include improving campaign execution, maintaining reliable system processes, supporting new proof-of-concept initiatives, and identifying trends or issues that can inform future marketing decisions.


Task and deliverables:

  • Build, launch, and monitor email campaigns, messages, journeys, and audience segmentation within Salesforce Marketing Cloud.
  • Implement and support the full lifecycle of email and messaging initiatives, from development through testing, deployment, reporting, and optimization.
  • Develop reusable email templates, content assets, and campaign components using HTML, CSS, AMPscript, SSJS, and Salesforce Marketing Cloud tools.
  • Create and maintain audience segments, automations, and data-driven campaign logic using SQL and relevant SFMC modules.
  • Generate, review, and interpret email performance reports to identify trends, issues, and improvement opportunities.
  • Support campaign asset development, including selecting or adapting imagery and content elements that improve audience response.
  • Guide junior developers on Salesforce Marketing Cloud development activities, standards, and best practices.
  • Act as module lead and point of contact for one or more markets or countries.
  • Document system processes, recurring issues, campaign workflows, and technical recommendations for the project team.
  • Develop and support proof-of-concept initiatives for new Salesforce Marketing Cloud solutions and enhancements.


Required experience:

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, or equivalent professional experience.
  • Required: 6–7+ years of IT experience, including 3–4+ years of hands-on Salesforce Marketing Cloud experience.
  • Required: Strong knowledge of Salesforce Marketing Cloud and core email marketing, messaging, segmentation, and automation concepts.
  • Required: Experience with at least three Salesforce Marketing Cloud modules, such as Email Studio, Journey Builder, Mobile Studio, Contact Builder, Automation Studio, Content Builder, Advertising Studio, SQL, or audience creation.
  • Required: Experience writing moderately complex SQL queries for segmentation, reporting, or automation use cases.
  • Required: Hands-on experience with HTML, CSS, AMPscript, and SSJS for email and campaign development.
  • Required: Strong attention to detail and experience with email testing, quality assurance, and deployment validation.
  • Required: Understanding of Salesforce best practices for marketing automation, data management, campaign execution, and platform governance.
  • Required: Ability to work independently with a high degree of ownership in a geographically distributed team.

description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

title: Video Content Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em lauro de freitas. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em camaçari. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.

title: Remote Mathematics Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Remote Mathematics Specialist em feira de santana. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

About Turing:

Based in San Francisco, California, Turing is the world’s leading research accelerator for frontier AI labs and a trusted partner for global enterprises deploying advanced AI systems. Turing supports customers in two ways: first, by accelerating frontier research with high-quality data, advanced training pipelines, plus top AI researchers who specialize in coding, reasoning, STEM, multilinguality, multimodality, and agents; and second, by applying that expertise to help enterprises transform AI from proof of concept into proprietary intelligence with systems that perform reliably, deliver measurable impact, and drive lasting results on the P&L


Role Overview:

The Mathematical Systems & Abstract Reasoning Engineer is responsible for developing advanced reasoning datasets that evaluate and improve the capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs). This role involves designing novel mathematical systems, defining custom rules and axioms, and creating rigorous reasoning challenges that require models to interpret definitions, perform symbolic computations, derive properties, and construct logically sound proofs. The ideal candidate combines deep expertise in abstract mathematics with exceptional analytical and communication skills to produce self-contained, verifiable, and high-quality evaluation tasks.

What does day-to-day look like:

  • PhD / Doctorate
  • Designed and defined novel mathematical systems, operations, and axiomatic frameworks for reasoning evaluations.
  • Authored multi-step reasoning tasks involving symbolic manipulation, expression evaluation, and proof-based problem solving.
  • Developed deterministic solutions, detailed reasoning traces, and comprehensive scoring rubrics for model assessment.
  • Identified and addressed edge cases, ambiguities, and logical inconsistencies to ensure task robustness and reproducibility.
  • Collaborated with reviewers and AI/LLM teams to refine task definitions, evaluation criteria, and dataset quality standards.


Required Qualifications:

  • Strong foundation in abstract mathematics, formal logic, algebraic structures, discrete mathematics, or theoretical computer science.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in mathematics, computer science, data science, logic, or a related analytical discipline.
  • Proven ability to create structured reasoning problems that assess both conceptual understanding and procedural accuracy.
  • Excellent written communication skills with the ability to document rigorous definitions, proofs, and reasoning processes.
  • Experience evaluating LLM reasoning performance or developing AI training and assessment datasets is preferred.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required : 4 hours of overlap with PST.
  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract : 8 weeks.

title: Video Content Intern
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Video Content Intern em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Type: Internship, 6 hours/day (30 hours/week)

Compensation: R$2,000/month

About the Role

We're an early-stage stealth startup in the health and wellness space, building our brand from the ground up. We're looking for a creative, fast-moving video intern who can turn raw footage and ideas into scroll-stopping short-form content for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and ads. You'll work directly with the founder and play a key role in how our brand shows up on video. Great opportunity for someone early in their career who loves editing and wants real ownership over content that thousands of people will see.

What You'll Do

  • Edit short-form video for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and paid ads (15-60 second formats)
  • Turn influencer footage, raw clips, and simple briefs into polished, platform-ready videos
  • Add captions, text overlays, music, and light motion to make content engaging
  • Repurpose one piece of content into multiple formats and cuts
  • Format and optimize videos to spec for each platform
  • Help maintain an organized library of footage and assets
  • Occasionally create simple graphics or thumbnails to support video content

What We're Looking For

  • Fluent in English, written and spoken. The interview will be conducted in English.
  • Strong editing skills in CapCut, and/or CapCut, Premiere, or similar (essential)
  • A real sense for what makes short-form video engaging, hooks, pacing, retention
  • Fast turnaround, comfortable producing multiple edits per day
  • Organized and reliable with deadlines
  • Self-motivated; you'll get briefs and direction, but we want someone who brings ideas
  • Available 6 hours per day

Nice to Have

  • Experience editing for health, wellness, fitness, or DTC/e-commerce brands
  • Basic motion graphics or animation skills
  • An eye for trends, you watch a lot of TikTok and know what's working right now

What You'll Get

  • Real, hands-on experience producing content for a brand from day one
  • Direct mentorship from the founder
  • Flexible remote work
  • Room to grow into a larger creative role as the company scales


How to Apply

In your resume, add a link to a reel or portfolio of your video work, ideally short-form social content you've edited.

title: Staffing Specialist
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Staffing Specialist em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Who We Are


MAVI is on a mission to globalize the finance and accounting function by connecting the best talent in the world with high-performing US companies. We’re building the world’s largest network of top-tier finance talent, using an AI-powered platform for sourcing, vetting & matching, and disrupting a legacy $100Bn+ industry.



What the Platform Team Does at MAVI


Platform Management drives the strategic side of our recruiting ecosystem, interpreting client needs, aligning talent, and ensuring successful placements. The Platform team is responsible for running the core operations of MAVI’s talent marketplace. They manage the full journey, from understanding customer needs to matching talent, placing them in roles, and ensuring both sides have a great experience. Their work ensures the marketplace runs smoothly, efficiently, and with high-quality service.


About the Role


We’re hiring a Platform Specia list who can help drive the lifeblood of our talent marketplace - the end-to-end process from talent matching, talent placement & account management. This person will work directly with the current Platform Manager at MAVI and work as a tag team to close deals, manage ongoing engagements, resolve ad-hoc issues that arise, improve processes & work with the engineering team to inject automation into various workflows.



What You'll Do


  • Work with Leadership and the Platform Manager to understand job needs, ideal candidate profiles, and help match the right talent to open roles.
  • Serve as the main point of contact for MAVI customers , build trust, manage ongoing engagements, and keep them regularly updated.
  • Build strong, long-term relationships with customers by understanding their goals, preferences, and business needs.
  • Support the end-to-end matching process by reviewing candidate documentation and identifying best-fit talent for open positions.
  • Write compelling, clear, and engaging job descriptions to attract talent from our internal network and match them with active opportunities.
  • Assist in creating professional and polished candidate profiles for presentation to customers.
  • Provide support throughout the hiring process, ensuring consistent communication between talent and customers to keep things moving.
  • Resolve issues that arise during active engagements, ensuring alignment, satisfaction, and long-term success for both parties.
  • Collaborate with leadership and other internal teams to refine and enhance our account and engagement management processes.


What We’re Looking For


  • At least 4-9 years of experience in account management, staffing, recruitment coordination, or a related role.
  • Very strong English communication skills, both written and verbal, is a must.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, and customer relationships in a dynamic environment.
  • Proven ability to work in high-speed environments, to operate with high urgency, and be extremely customer-centric.
  • High level of discretion and judgment when handling confidential or sensitive information.
  • Experience working with global clients or in remote-first environments.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment and adapt quickly to change.
  • Exceptional communication, organizational, interpersonal, and problem-solving skills, with a proactive and strategic approach.
  • Someone who is humble, hungry and best in class at what they do.


Why You Should Join


  • Impact: You’re not just another cog in the machine; you’ll help build the talent acquisition motion ground up that powers the entire business.
  • No Bureaucracy: Work directly with founders, move fast, and own meaningful projects. We’re playing to win here. This is a startup and we’re looking for new ideas, bold moves, and scrappiness.
  • Competitive Pay: We believe in sharing the upside with those who build it :)
  • Remote-first: Work from anywhere, but expect high velocity and deep collaboration.


Equal Opportunity Statement


At MAVI, we celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applicants of every background, identity, and life experience. Employment decisions are based on business needs, qualifications, and merit, without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.

title: Webflow Developer
description:
Confira esta oportunidade para Webflow Developer em salvador. Veja os detalhes da vaga, requisitos e como se candidatar.

Job description


BX Studio, a leading Webflow design-and-development agency, is looking for an experienced Senior Webflow Developer to own and elevate our most complex web projects. You’ll collaborate closely with designers, strategists, and junior developers to deliver pixel-perfect, high-performance sites—on time, on budget, and at the cutting edge of Webflow’s capabilities. Fluency in English and a friendly, professional demeanor are essential.


What you’ll do

  • Lead builds end-to-end—from scoping and wireframes to launch and post-launch optimizations.
  • Architect scalable Webflow systems (components, class structures, CMS schema) using Client-First or similar methodologies.
  • Mentor and review junior developers, establishing best practices for accessibility, performance, and responsive design.
  • Implement advanced features such as memberships, logic flows, complex animations, e-commerce, API and Zapier/Make integrations, and custom code embeds.
  • Translate design files (Figma/Sketch/Adobe XD) into production-ready Webflow sites with perfect fidelity and micro-interaction polish.
  • Optimize SEO, page speed, and analytics, ensuring Lighthouse and Core Web Vitals targets are met.
  • Interface directly with clients and internal stakeholders, providing technical guidance, accurate estimates, and proactive solutions.
  • Continuously improve our workflow, researching new Webflow releases, no-code tools, and automation to keep BX Studio at the forefront of the industry.


Role requirements

  • 3+ years of professional Webflow development (or 6+ years front-end with 3+ in Webflow).
  • Demonstrated portfolio of complex, high-traffic Webflow sites—including CMS, e-commerce, and custom interactions.
  • Expert-level understanding of Client-First nomenclature and component libraries (Relume, Flowbase, etc.).
  • Proficiency with HTML5, CSS/SCSS, JavaScript (ES6+), and REST/GraphQL APIs; comfortable writing custom code when Webflow’s native tools aren’t enough.
  • Sharp eye for detail and commitment to pixel-perfect execution across breakpoints and browsers.
  • Leadership and mentorship experience—able to set code standards, run code reviews, and upskill teammates.
  • Strong project-management skills: accurate scoping, clear documentation, and a track record of hitting deadlines.
  • High degree of reliability, initiative, and integrity in a fully remote environment.
  • Availability to work core hours in either EST or PST time zones.
